script:
control-agent-server conversation send "$K" --text 'hi' --no-run
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server conversation wait "$K" --until running --timeout 60
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K" --check execution_status eq paused --save F05.restart-running-graceful/get
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/events/count" --query kind=$PAUSE_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$K/events/count" --query kind=$INTERRUPT_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server doctor
